Name: Get Mail EML File
Author: Admin

Parameters.Description: Folder to fetch from. Default is Inbox. '/' separator can be used to specify a subfolder to search in, example: Inbox/Subfolder

AIDescription:
### General Description
Fetches the EML file of a specific email message from a Microsoft Exchange mailbox using its Message ID. This action retrieves the full MIME content of the email, which is useful for forensic analysis and manual review of suspicious messages.

### Parameters Description
| Parameter | Type | Mandatory | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Message ID | String | Yes | The unique identifier of the email message to fetch. |
| Folder Name | String | No | The mailbox folder to search in (e.g., Inbox, SentItems). Defaults to 'Inbox'. |
| Base64 Encode | Boolean | Yes | If true, the EML content will be returned as a base64 encoded string. Defaults to true. |

### Additional Notes
This action does not run on entities; it requires a specific Message ID as input. It supports S/MIME decryption and verification if the integration is configured with the appropriate certificates and private keys.

### Flow Description
1. Initialize the Exchange manager instance.
2. Search for the email message in the specified folder using the provided Message ID.
3. If the message is found, handle S/MIME decryption or verification if necessary.
4. Extract the MIME content (EML) of the message.
5. Add the EML file as an attachment to the Google SecOps case.
6. Return the EML content (raw or base64) as the action result.
